correction_ledger.finding: Boots rolled onto side edges in walk/run
correction_ledger.cause: Uncorrected lateral foot rotation; the prior pitch median also included airborne feet.
correction_ledger.fix: Level the whole sole across its width, retain source heel/toe pitch and heading, sample fast clips at 60 Hz; verify deformed soles at 120 Hz.

correction_ledger.cause: Authoring reset pelvis and every leg bone to rest.
correction_ledger.fix: Native knee extension, weight shift, torso turn and foot pivot; refit elbow and support approach; retain original event timing.

correction_ledger.cause: The event-timing pass inserted an identical aim pose from 0.625 to 1.25 seconds.
correction_ledger.fix: Retime the reviewed raise to 1.05 seconds, settle the support hand before the unchanged 1.25-second release, preserve 1.75-second duration and all seven other clips.

correction_ledger.finding: User requested a slightly faster wind-up
correction_ledger.fix: Raise completes at 0.90 seconds instead of 1.05; preserve continuous support approach, 1.25-second release and recovery.

correction_ledger.finding: User requested at least 2x speed over attack frames 44–60
correction_ledger.fix: Compress that exact segment at 2.5x, shift recovery earlier, mark clip release at 1.05 s. Runtime event fitting yields 2.1x speed while keeping native gameplay timing. Export at 120 Hz to preserve fast motion.
